name: SocialAPI
description:
SocialAPI connects Claude to the social media accounts your brand manages, so you can run your inbox and your publishing calendar from a conversation.

Inbox: read and reply to comments, hide, like, or delete them, and send private replies. Read and answer direct messages. Reply to Google Business Profile reviews and track mentions of your accounts.

Publishing: draft, schedule, and publish posts with images or video to several platforms at once. Check each platform's content limits before posting, and pull post metrics once it goes live.

Account management: connect new social accounts, group them into brands, invite clients to connect their own accounts, and set up webhooks for inbox and publishing events.

Supported platforms: Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, X, Telegram, WhatsApp, and Zalo. Available features vary by platform.

Try asking Claude:
- "Show me unanswered Instagram comments from the last 24 hours and draft replies."
- "Hide the spam comments on yesterday's Facebook post."
- "Schedule this announcement on LinkedIn and Threads for Monday at 9am."
- "Reply to this week's new Google reviews with a short thank-you."
- "Which of last month's posts got the most engagement?"

Requirements: a SocialAPI.AI account with at least one connected social account. Connecting X requires your own X developer app credentials.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SocialAPI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SocialAPI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.social-api.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SocialAPI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SocialAPI lists 79 MCP tools, including social_api_connect_account, social_api_create_brand, social_api_create_export, social_api_create_invite, social_api_create_post, social_api_create_webhook, social_api_delete_brand, social_api_delete_comment, social_api_delete_media, social_api_delete_post, social_api_delete_review_reply, and social_api_delete_webhook.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SocialAPI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SocialAPI in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
SocialAPI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SocialAPI is developed by SocialAPI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
